description: The line plot illustrates the BLEU score as a function of training epochs for three distinct data subsets: “Regular members,” “Held-out data,” and an unlabeled orange line that appears to represent a third category (possibly “Counterfactual members” or a control group, though not explicitly labeled in the legend). The x-axis, labeled “Epochs,” spans from 0 to 3.0 with major tick marks at 0.5 intervals, indicating a linear scale. The y-axis, labeled “BLEU score,” ranges from 0.00 to 0.35, with major gridlines at 0.05 intervals, also on a linear scale. The “Regular members” line (blue, solid) begins near 0.02 at epoch 0, rises gradually to approximately 0.06 by epoch 1.0, then plateaus with minor fluctuations around 0.06–0.07 through epoch 3.0. The “Held-out data” line (green, solid) starts near 0.03, peaks slightly above 0.04 around epoch 0.5, then declines to approximately 0.035 by epoch 1.0 and remains relatively flat with small oscillations near 0.03 through epoch 3.0. The unlabeled orange line (solid) begins near 0.02, rises sharply to 0.10 by epoch 0.5, continues climbing steeply to 0.25 by epoch 1.5, then increases more gradually to peak near 0.36 at epoch 2.5 before slightly declining to 0.35 at epoch 3.0. The plot includes a light gray rectangular background behind the legend, which partially obscures the orange line in the legend area. Gridlines are dashed and light gray, aiding in visual alignment of data points.
